original_sha256 identifies the publisher FLV; source sha256 identifies the prior matched H264/PCM source, not the downloadable FLV. Source normalization is prepare_video_timing_upgrade.py matched_group at application base 52646e2; rendering/compositing is prepare_mouth_edit_v4.py.

Generated byte hashes identify the actual evaluated files. Library/device/container metadata can change regenerated bytes; record differences and recompute exact changed-pixel masks rather than silently substituting them.
Requested same-frame/earlier mouth ratios are conditioning, not independently verified perfect synchronization or exact achieved output lag.
Actor identities, sentence templates and generator family are consumed; these cases must not be reused as fresh confirmation. No outside reviewer has participated.
